messages:
elaine (sec): FYI - after the RBAC tighten we pushed at 08:05 UTC I'm seeing a small spike of KMS decrypt denies and mTLS handshakes failing for service-to-service traffic in eu-west-1 and ap-south-1. Error snippets: `KMS:AccessDeniedException: arn:aws:kms:...:decrypt` and `tls: handshake error: remote error: handshake failure`. Spike ~08:12-08:18 UTC. Anyone oncall?

jai (infra): looking. The change removed a broad `kms:Decrypt` on the legacy-keystore role in favor of scoped principals. It was intentional but maybe a customer role got caught. tagging @omar for logs and @certrotator-bot to see rotator health.

omar (sre): grabbing audit logs now. I see multiple CloudTrail entries with `EventName=Decrypt` and `ErrorCode=AccessDenied`. Example: `2026-03-22T08:13:11Z principal=svc-rotator@eu-west-1 action=Decrypt resource=arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111:key/abcd Error=AccessDenied`. Those lines line up with TLS handshake failures from proxy logs: `proxy: peer closed connection during TLS handshake`.

certrotator-bot: rotator attempt failed: service=cert-rotator region=ap-south-1 attempt=42 status=FAIL reason=KMSAccessDenied. Next retry in 30s.

lisa (product): is the rotator the thing causing active connections to break? Or only new connections during certificate swap? We should prefer fast mitigation if customer-facing.

elaine (sec): From initial look, failures are mostly during reissuance and when services attempt to unwrap private keys. If rotator can't decrypt the private key material, the proxy can't present cert -> new TLS handshakes fail. Older connections may maintain. So yes, new connections can be impacted during rotation windows.

jai (infra): quick mitigation options: 1) revert RBAC delta to restore `kms:Decrypt` for the rotator principal, 2) add a short temporary allow in the region-specific IAM policy, 3) temporarily disable automatic rotation for affected regions while we fix roles. Which should we do?

omar (sre): I'd do 3 + 2: pause rotation to stop creating degraded certs, and put a targeted allow so existing running rotators can decrypt and finish pending swaps. Revert is heavier and touches more principals.

elain e (sec): small note: if we add allow, ensure we create an audit alert query for KMS Deny->Allow flips and set runbook link.

lisa (product): agree with pause + targeted allow. Customers in eu-west/ap-south are impacted. ETA for pause?

jai (infra): pausing rotator in both regions now. Command: `kubectl -n infra set env deployment/cert-rotator ROTATION_ENABLED=false --region=eu-west-1,ap-south-1` (runbook step). Also patching IAM policy to re-add `kms:Decrypt` for `arn:aws:iam::111:role/legacy-keystore-rotator` scoped to the two regions.

omar (sre): verifying logs after pause... rotator error rate drops in eu-west within 60s. TLS handshake fail counts decreasing.

elaine (sec): after we stabilize, we should do root cause: why did the RBAC change remove that principal? Was it an overly broad script? Need to ensure tests catch cross-region principals for keystone roles.

jai (infra): root cause: the policy generator inferred principals from prefix and we had an exception filter that excluded `legacy-*` roles. Bug is `ignoreLegacy == true` but it matched `legacy-keystore-rotator` incorrectly in the region filter. Fix is to update the generator to consider region tag and to add an automated KMS decrypt smoke test to PR checks.

lisa (product): action items: 1) pause rotations (done), 2) temporary IAM allow (in progress), 3) add alert for KMS AccessDenied spikes (eli, oma?), 4) postmortem + change to policy generator and test harness.

omar (sre): I'll open the alert: name `security.kms.decrypt.denies.spike` - threshold 10 denies/min across any region.

certrotator-bot: rotator now running with ROTATION_ENABLED=false in eu-west-1,ap-south-1. Pending decrypt queue drained.

elaine (sec): for long-term TLS hardening we should also do: - verify client cert fallback behavior (don't drop existing sessions on rotation), - increase observability on cert unwrap latency, - ensure cipher-suite policy is strict but has graceful fallbacks for cross-region older clients.

jai (infra): agreed. I'll add unit test in policy-generator repo and an integration smoke that attempts a KMS decrypt with the service role before policy rollout.

lisa (product): I'll coordinate customer communications for impacted orgs and mark this as SEV-3 for now.

elain e (sec): owners: jai and omar. ETA for permanent fix PR?

jai (infra): PR opened: https://git.internal/r/policy-generator/pulls/314 — includes region tag fix and a CI KMS-decrypt smoke. Requesting review.

omar (sre): monitoring shows handshake failures back to baseline after the patch. Will keep alerting on for 24h.

elaine (sec): thanks team. Postmortem template assigned to jai. We'll include runbook update to pause rotation as a safeguarded step in future rollouts. :white_check_mark:
